d: Precomputing the cumulative sum of an array to answer range sum queries in O(1) time.

p: A Prefix Sum array stores the cumulative sum of elements up to each index. This allows us to answer 'What is the sum of elements from index L to R?' in O(1) time instead of O(N) time.
1. Create an array `prefix` of the same length + 1.
3. To get sum between L and R: `prefix[R] - prefix[L-1]`

class NumArray:
    def __init__(self, nums):
        self.prefix = [0] * (len(nums) + 1)
        for i in range(len(nums)):
            self.prefix[i+1] = self.prefix[i] + nums[i]

    def sumRange(self, left, right):
        return self.prefix[right + 1] - self.prefix[left]
Time: O(N) to build, O(1) per query. Space: O(N) for the prefix array.

Array:  [  3,   1,   4,   1,   5 ]
Prefix: [  3,   4,   8,   9,  14 ]

Sum(idx 1 to 3) = Prefix[3] - Prefix[0]
                =    9      -    3      = 6
(1 + 4 + 1 = 6)
